title: Moving boxes are a count, not a price
transcript:
Rosa Delgado (owner): The storeroom move is Saturday morning.
Rosa Delgado (owner): We need 15 boxes from Boxdrop for the move.
Rosa Delgado (owner): I'll pay Boxdrop $64 for those boxes on Monday.

traps.description: Rosa needs 15 boxes. That count is not a price of $15.
